title: How Beavers Reshape Entire River Ecosystems
hook: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.

scenes.narration: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.
In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations with combined population numbers being estimated.
The concept became popular in conservation and was deployed in a range of contexts.
The concept was mobilized to engender support for conservation especially where human activities had damaged ecosystems.
In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas which protected beavers.
Wolves protected beavers from having their food sources encroached upon by grazing animals.
The connectivity of streams to their adjacent floodplain along their entire length plays an important role.
Stream restoration or river restoration is a set of activities that aim to improve environmental health.
